# Agent Tools

> A curated directory of tools, APIs, MCP servers, SDKs and frameworks for AI agents, in English and Spanish, maintained by fluyeporlaweb.

Maintainer: Pablo, fluyeporlaweb (https://x.com/fluyeporlaweb).
License: MIT (https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/ai-agent-tools/blob/main/LICENSE).
Repository: https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/ai-agent-tools
Sponsor: https://fluyeporlaweb.com/patrocina

## What this is

An awesome list, not a monorepo of every tool we build. Entries are curated (one line, one working link). Some links are affiliates and go through https://fluyeporlaweb.com/go/; they are marked in the README.

## Built by fluyeporlaweb

- mcp-x-intelligence: MCP server for X/Twitter research. Status: coming soon. Standalone repo: https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/mcp-x-intelligence
- Apify actors: scrapers and automations published at https://apify.com/fluyeporlaweb
